models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest identities used for anonymous access and device-based tracking without permanent credentials.

Each record represents one anonymous visitor identity that can own short-lived guest sessions without becoming a registered member account. The table is the root identity record for guest-specific activity and must remain separate from authenticated member data and from guest session records in {@link todo_app_guest_sessions}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the guest identity was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when the guest identity was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Time when the guest identity was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session records for anonymous guest access. Each row belongs to exactly one {@link todo_app_guests} record and stores the connection context needed to manage short-lived guest state, track access timing, and support logout or expiration handling.

This table is a pure session entity: it does not store business content, only the guest owner reference and security/audit metadata for the session lifecycle.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current or last visited URL associated with the guest session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL associated with the guest session request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session expires.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts for authenticated access to the private todo application.

This table stores the canonical identity record for a signed-in member, including the email address and password hash used for authentication. It is the root actor entity for all member-owned data such as {@link todo_app_todos} and {@link todo_app_user_profiles}, while session and recovery workflows are handled in separate child tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Member login email address used for authentication and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for member authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session records for {@link todo_app_members} used to manage member login, refresh, and logout behavior.

Each record stores one authenticated session instance together with connection metadata and expiration time for security auditing. The table is append-only in practice and exists only as a child of the member actor table.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL or client location associated with the session creation event.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded at the time the session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session becomes invalid and can no longer be used.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for {@link todo_app_members} account recovery and password change workflows.

Each record represents a single reset request issued for one member account. The table stores the secure token, the account it belongs to, and the timestamps needed to validate whether the reset link is still usable. It is a supporting authentication table and is not intended for direct user browsing or general business operations.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account that owns this reset token. {@link todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure one-time reset token used to verify password recovery requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset token was redeemed, if it has been used.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Stores email verification tokens issued to member accounts during registration or email change confirmation flows.

Each record belongs to exactly one member account and represents a single verification lifecycle, including the token used, the time it was issued, and when it was confirmed or expired. This table exists only to support account activation and trust validation for {@link todo_app_members} and is not meant to be used as a standalone business entity.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account that owns this email verification token. {@link todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque verification token sent to the member for confirming the email address.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was successfully consumed and the email address was confirmed.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the verification token must no longer be accepted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for administrative removal or cleanup of obsolete records.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Stores each member's private todo item, including ownership, title, optional description, optional start and due dates, completion state, and soft-delete status.

This table is the current-state record for a todo. It supports private list browsing, detail viewing, completion toggling, editing, trash management, restore, and permanent deletion workflows. Edit history is preserved in the separate {@link todo_app_todo_histories} table, so this model only contains the latest todo state.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title shown in todo lists and detail views.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional todo description shown in the detail view.

plainFields.name: start_at
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo.

plainFields.name: due_at
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Whether the todo is currently completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this todo record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this todo record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this todo was soft deleted; null means it is active.

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories
models.description:
Stores one immutable edit-history entry for a todo item. Each row records when an edit occurred and the resulting title, description, start date, and due date values for the changed fields so the full change trail can be viewed in chronological order.

This table is a historical snapshot trail for {@link todo_app_todos} and is only meaningful in the context of its parent todo. It is append-only by design and supports the private todo app’s requirement to preserve the edit history of each user-owned todo until the parent todo is permanently removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Parent todo for this history entry. References {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history entry was recorded for the todo edit.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title after the edit, if the title was changed as part of this history entry.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Todo description after the edit, if the description was changed as part of this history entry.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Todo start date after the edit, if the start date was changed as part of this history entry.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Todo due date after the edit, if the due date was changed as part of this history entry.

models.name: todo_app_user_profiles
models.description:
Stores the private profile for one member account, including the account holder's display name used for in-app identification.

This record is strictly owner-scoped and is not publicly browsable. It exists separately from authentication credentials so profile data can be managed without exposing login information, and it is linked one-to-one with {@link todo_app_members} through a unique ownership relationship.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owning member account for this private profile. References {@link todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Private display name shown within the application for the owning member.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this profile record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this profile record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this profile record was soft deleted. Null when active.
